var_index: samples were intersected on Ensembl gene ID (the references differ between samples), then the index was switched to make.unique'd gene symbols for marker lookup
doublets_removed: 1876 cells called by Scrublet run independently per capture; scores retained in the metadata for every cell
hvg_method: seurat_v3 on raw counts, n_top_genes=2500, batch_key=sample_id
normalization: normalize_total(target_sum=1e4) + log1p; the raw counts are preserved in processed/postQC.h5ad and re-attached as layers['counts'] of the final object
n_pcs: 50 (variance-ratio elbow at 6, 90% cumulative variance at 51, bracketed to [20,50])
batch_assessment: {'knn_same_sample_enrichment': 2.658, 'mean_same_sample_neighbour_fraction': 0.8861, 'expected_by_chance': 0.3367, 'within_group_replicate_enrichment': None, 'replicate_structure_available': False, 'decision_rule': 'No condition or group metadata exists for this series, so donor, batch and biology are completely confounded and no correction can be justified as purely technical. The unintegrated embedding is kept as primary; a Harmony embedding is computed alongside it, clearly labelled as supplementary, if samples separate strongly.', 'integration_recommended': False, 'supplementary_harmony_warranted': True}
batch_correction: NOT applied to the primary embedding. This series has no condition metadata, so donor, batch and biology cannot be separated and no correction can be justified as purely technical. A Harmony embedding on sample_id is nevertheless provided as a clearly labelled SUPPLEMENTARY representation (X_pca_harmony, X_umap_harmony) because samples do separate in PCA space (kNN same-sample enrichment 2.658). It must not be used for condition comparisons.
clustering: Leiden (igraph flavour, 2 iterations) scanned at resolutions [0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0]; primary resolution 1.0 selected because it was the finest resolution with no cluster below 20 cells and >=90% of clusters supported by at least 5 specific marker genes. All resolutions are retained as leiden_res* columns.
marker_test: Wilcoxon rank-sum (scanpy rank_genes_groups, one cluster vs all remaining cells) on log1p(CP10K) values, with expressing fractions
annotation_strategy: candidate identities scored per cluster from z-scored mean expression of curated panels, down-weighted by the fraction of cells expressing each marker; numeric Leiden labels are preserved and no candidate is promoted to a definitive label
epithelial_subanalysis_selection: clusters ['11', '12', '16', '17', '26', '27', '28', '35', '36', '39', '40'] selected on combined evidence (mean z of ['EPCAM', 'CDH1', 'KRT8', 'KRT18', 'SFTPC', 'SCGB1A1', 'FOXJ1', 'AGER', 'KRT5'] minus mean z of ['PTPRC', 'PECAM1', 'COL1A1', 'DCN', 'CDH5'] > 0.5 AND >25% of cells expressing a pan-epithelial marker) - not on any single gene
epithelial_subanalysis: performed on 6968 cells from clusters ['11', '12', '16', '17', '26', '27', '28', '35', '36', '39', '40']; 20 epithelial subclusters at Leiden resolution 0.6
